name: gmail_list_messages
description: List messages in your inbox with optional filtering by label or read status. Returns message IDs, thread IDs, and preview text. Use gmail_search for complex queries like date ranges or attachments.

query.description: Gmail search query to filter messages (e.g., "from:alice subject:meeting")

max_results.description: Maximum number of messages to return (default 10, max 100)

page_token.description: Token for fetching the next page of results

name: gmail_get_message
description: Fetch full email details by message ID. Returns headers, subject, body text, sender, recipients, attachments, and applied labels.

message_id.description: The ID of the message to retrieve

format.description: Format of the returned message (default: full)

name: gmail_search
description: Search emails using Gmail query syntax (e.g., 'from:sender@example.com', 'subject:invoice', 'has:attachment', 'after:2024/01/01', 'is:unread'). Returns matching message IDs.

max_results.description: Maximum number of messages to return (default 10, max 100)

name: gmail_send
description: Send an email with recipient, subject, and body text. Optionally add CC, BCC, reply-to address, and file attachments.

name: gmail_list_labels
description: Get all your labels including system folders (INBOX, SENT, TRASH, DRAFTS) and custom labels. Returns label names and IDs for filtering or organizing.
